title: Umutangabuhamya w'Inkongi y'Umuriro
intro: Umuntu w’umuhanga, wiyemeje kuvumbura ukuri kw’ukuri, yatangiye urugendo rwo kuvumbura ibintu mu buryo bw’umwuka. Ukwizera kwabo kudacogora kwatumye bagerageza amahame yashyizweho, bahura n’ibigeragezo bikomeye byageragezaga aho ukwizera kwabo kugarukira. Inkuru y’ubugingo ni igihamya cy’uburinzi n’ubuyobozi bw’Imana.
clues: Nahawe umugisha n'izina ryihariye riturutse ku Mwami wanjye, risobanura isano ikomeye kandi idasanzwe.
Ubuzima bwanjye bwo mu bwana nabumaze ndi mu bantu bapfukamiraga ibishushanyo byakozwe, ariko umutima wanjye wari ufite icyifuzo cyo kubona Imana Imwe y'Ukuri.
Narebye ibiri mu kirere, izuba, ukwezi n'inyenyeri, ntekereza ku kuzamuka no kugwa kwabyo, nsanga bidashobora kuba Umwami wanjye.
Mu gikorwa cyo kwigomeka ku mana nyinshi zari zisanzwe, nahanganye n'imana z'ibinyoma, nsiga imwe yonyine, nini, imeze nk'iy'umushinja bucece.
Guhangana kwanjye n'ibishushanyo byanteye igihano gikomeye, kuko naciriwe urubanza rwo gutabwa mu muriro ukaze.
Nyamara, ku itegeko ry'Umuremyi wanjye, umuriro mwinshi wahindutse isoko y'ubukonje n'umutekano, urinda ubuzima bwanjye.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
